content: The following information pertains to the labeling and packaging of Cephalexin products manufactured by Teva Pharmaceuticals USA, Sellersville, PA, 18960, with a revision date of Q1/2012: 1. Cephalexin Capsules USP 250 mg (100 Capsules) National Drug Code (NDC): 0093-3145-01 Product Name: Cephalexin Capsules USP, 250 mg Prescription Status: Rx only Quantity: 100 capsules 2. Cephalexin Capsules USP 500 mg (100 Capsules) National Drug Code (NDC): 0093-3147-01 Product Name: Cephalexin Capsules USP, 500 mg Prescription Status: Rx only Quantity: 100 capsules 3. Cephalexin for Oral Suspension USP 125 mg per 5 mL (100 mL) National Drug Code (NDC): 0093-4175-73 Product Name: Cephalexin for Oral Suspension USP, 125 mg per 5 mL when reconstituted according to directions Usual Pediatric Dose: 25 to 50 mg per kg per day, divided into four doses For more severe infections, the dose may be doubled Prescription Status: Rx only Administration: For oral use only Volume: 100 mL (when mixed) 4. Cephalexin for Oral Suspension USP 250 mg per 5 mL (100 mL) National Drug Code (NDC): 0093-4177-73 Product Name: Cephalexin for Oral Suspension USP, 250 mg per 5 mL when reconstituted according to directions Usual Pediatric Dose: 25 to 50 mg per kg per day, divided into four doses For more severe infections, the dose may be doubled Prescription Status: Rx only Administration: For oral use only Volume: 100 mL (when mixed) For all products, accompanying literature should be consulted for additional information.
